sections.heading: Browse and buy
sections.body: Browse filters the market by item category. Commodity markets group interchangeable resources, consumables, and Essences into buy and sell order books; unique equipment is listed as exact items. Always review quantity, unit price, and total before confirming.

sections.heading: Sell and place orders
sections.body: Sell selects eligible inventory items and either fills matching demand or creates a listing at your chosen price. Commodity markets can also accept buy orders. Restrictions shown by the action panel must be resolved before an order can be submitted.

sections.heading: My Orders and access
sections.body: My Orders contains your active listings and buy orders and provides their cancellation actions. Cinders committed to an order or items committed to a listing remain tied to that order until it fills or is cancelled. Guest accounts must be registered before using the Bazaar.
